proves.claim: The Flow panel model returns one row per flow item with its id and cause, and one entry per idle seat with its seat name and reason.

view.flow-panel-model.one-row-per-item-a.why: Without it the Flow panel could drop an unlanded item or an idle seat and nobody would see where the release is stuck.

proves.claim: A flow document with no items and no idle seats gives empty rows and an empty idle list.

view.flow-panel-model.empty-document-giv.why: Without it an idle board could make the panel throw instead of drawing an empty state.
